name: web/Session cookie missing HttpOnly flag
description: [low] Hardening proof (CWE-1004): a session-ish Set-Cookie is served WITHOUT HttpOnly = script-readable session token. The regex requires a Set-Cookie line naming sess/sid/auth/token/jwt/login AND forbids 'httponly' anywhere on that line. Keywords: cookie httponly session flags secure hardening cwe-1004. ctrl: benign response sets HttpOnly -> the forbidden-flag regex cannot match -> not falsified. base_url = host serving the authenticated cookie (skill rides /login).
